snippet.title: Make More! - Android Gameplay
snippet.description:
Welcome to the world of factory business!

Start with just one factory and one employee in this silly work simulator. Hire more, build more, and make more to become an industry-leading big shot. You're the boss! And the boss of the bosses! At least until you meet THE BIG BOSS...

Developed by Bad Crane
Also released on iOS
